name: render
description: On-demand, fully-offline diagram/markup rendering for Claude Code: the /render command wraps a bundled script that turns a mermaid, Chart.js, SVG, or HTML block into a self-contained HTML file and prints a file:// URL. Nothing leaves the machine (no CDN at render time, no third-party live editor) — safe for content that encodes sensitive detail. Cross-platform: Linux, macOS, WSL, Windows.
